CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
|-- CanvasHistoryService: openContext, state, resolve, document, append, navigate, reset
|-- This boundary manages canvas history and its storage; controllers coordinate edits.
|-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService: private contexts = WeakMap<CanvasEditingContext, CanvasHistory>
|-- Object handles isolate viewers of the same persisted context and permit collection.
|-- openContext(document, view, record?) -> new CanvasHistory(...) -> frozen { contextId }
|-- Runtime handles and service instances are excluded from saved canvases.
|-- state(context) -> { checkpointId, document, view, canUndo, canRedo }
|-- State reads require a known handle and derive values from the current history head.
|-- resolve(context, diagramId) -> history.diagrams.resolve(history.contextId, diagramId)
|-- The service exposes resolved diagrams without making callers interpret revision tables.
|-- append(context, document, view, correspondence?) -> history.append(...)
|-- The controller supplies node correspondence when recording edited content.
|-- navigate(context, redo) -> navigationTransactionId(redo); history.navigate(redo)
|-- Linked transfer navigation rejects local undo and requires workspace coordination.
|-- exportContext, persistenceChanges, forkContext, adopt -> CanvasHistory [schematic delegation]
|-- Transport adapters expose history records and deltas across the service boundary.
|-- prepareTransfer(...) -> prepareCanvasTransfer(exportedSource, input, exportedDestination?)
|-- Preparation requires source history, transfer input and optional destination history.
|-- prepareTransferNavigation(...) -> prepareTransferNavigation(source.export(), destination.export(), tx, redo)
|-- Both participant histories are required for coordinated transfer navigation.
|-- MappingPage.transfer -> runWorkspaceTask({ type: 'transfer', source, destination, input })
|-- The page checks the captured source checkpoint before preparing a copy or move.
|-- MappingPage.undo -> boundary(id, redo) -> source.prepareTransferNavigation(destination, tx, redo)
|-- Undo requires both canvases and rejects newer applied transfers sharing a participant.
|-- publishTransfer: await storage.save(workspace); installWorkspace(workspace) [schematic]
|-- Installation replaces sessions only after the workspace save acknowledges.
|-- WorkspacePersistence: cursors: WeakMap<CanvasSession, number>; known: Map<string, CanvasDraft>
|-- The adapter manages subscriptions and translates live state into per-document records.
|-- sync(ids) -> controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> historyChanges(id, delta)
|-- New sessions replace obsolete graph records while retaining existing immutable revisions.
|-- captureDisplay(id, canvas.display), captureCamera(id, viewport) -> stored view values [schematic]
|-- History records, metadata, baselines, canvas state and workspace index share a storage batch.
|-- RecordStorage: private cache, pending, flight, sequence, persisted, revision, listeners
|-- Storage manages cached records, queued changes, in-flight writes and retry timers.
|-- batch(changes) -> pending.set(key, change); pump() -> transport.write(flight.batch)
|-- Each flight retains one request ID and expected storage revision across retries.
|-- commit(changes): flush prior work -> batch -> flush acknowledgement [schematic]
|-- Definitive rejection restores the cache; ambiguous responses retry the identical request.
|-- WorkspaceStorage: private worker, requests, ready; records?: RecordStorage
|-- The storage wrapper creates and terminates its worker and rejects outstanding requests on close.
|-- save(snapshot) -> load() -> records.flush() -> project(snapshot) -> records.commit(changes)
|-- Worker projection supplies record changes; its implementation is outside the pinned excerpts.
|-- retireTransactions(context, ids) -> history.retireTransactions(ids)
`-- Deleting a canvas retires its transfer links in remaining controllers before flushing.
